# XNXX.COM

> XNXX is a large adult video platform for browsing, searching, and streaming free porn videos, photos, and related media.

XNXX organizes adult content through categories, tags, pornstars, channels, rankings, and search, while also providing account features, uploads, and legal/compliance resources through its info subdomain.

## Core Browsing
- [Homepage](https://www.xnxx.com/): Main entry point for featured, trending, and newly published videos.
- [Best Videos](https://www.xnxx.com/best): Ranked collection of top-performing videos on the platform.
- [Hits](https://www.xnxx.com/hits): Most-viewed videos across the site with popularity-based ordering.
- [New Videos](https://www.xnxx.com/new/): Recently added videos for chronological browsing.
- [Search](https://www.xnxx.com/search/): Search interface for finding videos by keywords and phrases.

## Discovery & Taxonomy
- [Tags](https://www.xnxx.com/tags): Alphabetical tag index for topic-based content discovery.
- [Categories](https://www.xnxx.com/categories): Category directory for browsing videos by genre and theme.
- [Channels](https://www.xnxx.com/channels): Channel listings for publishers, studios, and curated content feeds.
- [Pornstars](https://www.xnxx.com/pornstars): Performer directory with profile pages and associated videos.
- [Pictures](https://www.xnxx.com/pictures): Image and photo browsing section for non-video adult content.

## Rankings & Popularity
- [Best of Month](https://www.xnxx.com/best-of-month): Monthly ranking of popular videos on the site.
- [Best of 6 Months](https://www.xnxx.com/best-of-6-months): Longer-term ranking of top videos over six months.
- [Best of Year](https://www.xnxx.com/best-of-year): Annual ranking page for the site's most popular videos.
- [Top Rated](https://www.xnxx.com/top): Ranking page focused on highly rated videos.
- [Trending](https://www.xnxx.com/trending): Currently trending videos based on recent activity.

## Community & User Content
- [Account Login](https://www.xnxx.com/account): Sign-in page for member access and account actions.
- [Create Account](https://www.xnxx.com/account/create): Registration page for creating a new user account.
- [Upload Video](https://www.xnxx.com/account/uploads/new): Submission interface for uploading user content.
- [My Account](https://www.xnxx.com/account/my): Member dashboard for account-related management.
- [Subscriptions](https://www.xnxx.com/account/subscriptions): Account area for managing followed channels or creators.

## Media Formats
- [Videos](https://www.xnxx.com/video/): Primary video content area for streaming adult clips.
- [Pictures](https://www.xnxx.com/pictures): Photo gallery section for image-based adult content.
- [GIFs](https://multi.xnxx.com/gifs): Animated GIF browsing section on the media subdomain.
- [Albums](https://multi.xnxx.com): Media gallery homepage for photos and related formats.

## International & Localized Access
- [XNXX English](https://www.xnxx.com/): Default English-language site experience.
- [XNXX Español](https://www.xnxx.es/): Spanish-language localized version of the platform.
- [XNXX Français](https://www.xnxx.fr/): French-language localized version of the platform.
- [XNXX Deutsch](https://www.xnxx.de/): German-language localized version of the platform.
- [XNXX Português](https://www.xnxx.com.br/): Portuguese-language localized version for Brazilian users.

## Legal & Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://info.xnxx.com/legal/tos): Terms governing site access, uploads, and platform usage.
- [Privacy Policy](https://info.xnxx.com/legal/privacy): Privacy policy describing data collection and processing practices.
- [Privacy Notice](https://info.xnxx.com/legal/privacynotice): Supplemental privacy notice covering user rights and disclosures.
- [2257 Compliance](https://info.xnxx.com/2257): Record-keeping compliance information for adult content regulations.
- [Content Removal](https://info.xnxx.com/content_removal): Copyright and takedown request process for reported content.

## Support & Contact
- [Contact](https://info.xnxx.com/contact): General contact page for support, inquiries, and reporting.
- [Help](https://info.xnxx.com/help): Help resources for common account and site issues.
- [Abuse Report](https://info.xnxx.com/abuse): Reporting channel for abuse, illegal content, or policy violations.
- [DMCA](https://info.xnxx.com/dmca): Copyright complaint information and DMCA reporting procedures.

## Company & Information
- [Info Portal](https://info.xnxx.com/): Information hub for legal, support, and company resources.
- [About](https://info.xnxx.com/about): Overview page describing the platform and related information.
- [Press](https://info.xnxx.com/press): Press and media contact information when available.
- [Careers](https://info.xnxx.com/jobs): Employment and hiring information for the company.
